decisions.reason: The cloud contact centre service builds on the firm's established offer and fits its hybrid cloud strategy, so keeping this option open costs little while its uncertain early prospects resolve, and one year of only a website mention reveals too little to justify abandoning it.

The call number routing platform sits close to the core voice business and already has its own page, which signals commitment; its upkeep cost is low and nothing in its results so far indicates its value will not be realized.
